_comment: Remora: the second hero / partner to Ennix. Sleek Arcane-style aesthetic: braided crown hair, sleeveless cream tunic with criss-cross lacing, leather bracer, dark combat trousers, tall boots. Source: 04 - Remora - airship outfit v1.png and 02 - Remora - original concept.png.
name: Remora
_asset_prefix: Prefixes every object, material and output file: assembly/Remora_Character_Review.blend, export/Remora_UE5.fbx, etc.

inputs._body_object: The acquired outfit mesh object inside body-acquisition.blend.

face_proportions._mouth_corner_lift_mm: Millimetres [right, left] corner lift: neutral determined mouth.

source_camera._comment: The orthographic reference frame measured by scripts/measure_source_frame.py on 04 - Remora - airship outfit v1.png (1024x1536).

_body_lift_m: Raises the acquired body so the sole vertices rest exactly on the floor (z=0).

body._hands_beyond_abs_x_m: Sleeveless / bracer: wrists start around |x| 0.65 m.

body_paint._side_band_abs_x_m: Width of side-view blend band; [0.0, 0.001] for 2-view (front/back) reference sets.
